prompt: Preciso de um diagrama de sequência do fluxo de checkout do nosso e-commerce pra colocar no README. Pode fazer?

assertions.text: Asks the user clarifying questions about the checkout flow (participants, trigger, sync vs async, failure handling, or level of technical detail) instead of only delivering a finished diagram
No fabricated technical specifics (endpoint paths, header names, payload fields, status codes) are presented as facts about the user's actual system

Either no mermaid code is delivered at all (the expected outcome when the flow is still unknown), or any block that is included parses cleanly — verified with mermaid-cli (exit 0) where the CLI is available, otherwise by syntax review against references/syntax.md, with the grader stating which of the two checks it actually ran

expected_output: Asks 2-4 targeted clarifying questions (participants, trigger, sync vs async, failure handling, level of technical detail) instead of delivering a diagram built on invented endpoints, payloads, or services. No fabricated technical details presented as the user's system.
